description: This file defines the HeadersFooters class, which manages a collection of header and footer objects within a document structure, including support for cloning, serialization, and visitor pattern traversal.

classes.name: HeadersFooters
classes.description: Represents a collection of header and footer objects associated with a section of the document, providing accessors, cloning, serialization, and visitor pattern functionalities.
